create_config_voxtral_realtime: create a VoxtralRealtimeConfig instance with default audio and text sub-configs for the Voxtral-Mini-4B-Realtime model
build_config_voxtral_realtime_text: build a VoxtralRealtimeTextConfig with transformer parameters like vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
build_config_voxtral_realtime_encoder: build a VoxtralRealtimeEncoderConfig with audio encoder parameters like num_mel_bins, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
configure_audio_text_subconfigs: configure audio and text sub-configs by passing dicts to VoxtralRealtimeConfig for merging with defaults
inspect_config_attributes: inspect VoxtralRealtimeConfig attributes like audio_length_per_tok, downsample_factor, and default_num_delay_tokens
